ios.desc:
WristGPT is a hands-free AI assistant built for any Apple Watch.

Ask quick questions, capture thoughts, dictate notes, and get useful answers without pulling out your phone. WristGPT is designed for moments when your hands are busy, your phone is out of reach, or you just want fast help on your wrist.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with AI from Apple Watch
• Use voice, text, swipe, or dictation
• Capture ideas, tasks, notes, and journal entries
• Transcribe spoken thoughts before you forget them
• Search the web for up-to-date answers
• Start on your Watch and continue later on iPhone

WHY WRISTGPT
Most AI apps are built for a phone or laptop. WristGPT is built for the wrist.

Replies are short, useful, and easy to read at a glance. You can ask a quick question, save a thought, or get help in the moment without falling into your phone.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Use WristGPT when you’re commuting, walking, cooking, travelling, working out, parenting, or moving between meetings.

It is for people who want the usefulness of AI without another screen taking over their attention.

WHAT’S NEW
This release makes WristGPT easier to start and more flexible to use.

• Voice Mode for hands-free conversations
• Transcription for capturing spoken thoughts quickly
• New Apple Watch onboarding
• New Free, Pro and Max subscription options
• More reliable chat history and voice transcripts
• Bug fixes and improvements for Apple Watch Series 4 and later

Minimal distractions. Maximum clarity.

Bring AI into everyday life, right from your wrist.
